comparison.objective: Remove a loose hex key obstructing a cabinet track and open the guided door; candidate uses a hex key to commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle extraction and prismatic door motion versus inserting that tool into a recessed screw, unlocking, fine adjustment, relocking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Door opens 288.23 mm while key stays in the work area and guide remains valid versus two safe, repeatable stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: A shared tool shape is insufficient; the key is debris in one task and an actively aligned torque tool in the other.
